capabilities: Generate frontmatter from a JSON or JavaScript template on save
Access file metadata, properties, tags, and Dataview data in templates
Run generation on a folder or the whole vault via commands
Exclude files or folders from generation with yaml-gen-ignore
extras: README warns the plugin is still under development and that hacking templates via global variables could break your vault; manual installation requires cloning and building with bun. Automatic generation on save requires wiring a command into the obsidian-custom-save plugin.
problem: Obsidian does not generate or keep frontmatter properties up to date on its own, so users must write and maintain YAML by hand in every note.

relations.evidence: install obsidian-custom-save and add the frontmatter-generator: run file command
you can only access this if you install and enable the dataview plugin

summary: Frontmatter generator that creates note properties from a JSON or JavaScript template each time a file is saved.
